entries.title: Resumable chunked uploads
entries.description: Reliability pattern behind Sync-Drive: chunked, resumable uploads with retries and integrity checks for flaky networks.

entries.title: Résumé → profile → autofill
entries.description: End-to-end flow: parse unstructured résumé PDFs, review extracted fields, and autofill applications through secured APIs.

entries.title: Real-time community messaging
entries.description: Typed React frontend and Node.js/PostgreSQL backend with WebSocket messaging for a scalable college community platform.

entries.title: Two-hop GCN on CORA
entries.description: Graph node classification with two-hop neighborhood aggregation and weighted loss to handle class imbalance (+15% over dense baselines).
entries.instructions: Key ideas: aggregate 2-hop neighbors for richer context, and use a weighted loss to improve convergence on imbalanced CORA classes. Evaluate against dense baselines with consistent splits.

entries.title: Extensible CLI shell
entries.description: PyOS pattern: modular command registration so new shell commands can be added in under 10 lines without touching core logic.
entries.instructions: Design commands as small modules behind a common interface; keep auth, scheduling, and execution concerns separated so the shell stays extensible.
